description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key field information from a motor vehicle registration certificate, including certificate category, barcode, registration authority, registration date, motor vehicle registration number, and more
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别机动车注册证所包含证件类别、条形编码、登记机关、登记日期、机动车登记编号等关键字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-vehicle-registration --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i1/O1CN01NA1F7A1cSO8cnFQ7m_!!6000000003599-0-tps-844-1125.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeVehicleRegistration

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
